subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` as the supported public channel-plugin contract for deferring visible final-mode TTS text into voice-note captions?
rationale: The patch changes shared core dispatch behavior based on a new plugin capability, so the permanent SDK boundary and its opt-in semantics require an owner choice beyond mechanical review.

options.title: Approve the capability contract
options.body: Keep the generic opt-in capability, subject to exact-head Telegram proof and focused compatibility validation.

options.title: Narrow to a Telegram-owned implementation
options.body: Reject the shared SDK addition and move any Telegram-specific delivery policy into the Telegram owner boundary if maintainers do not want this plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the capability contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic opt-in capability, subject to exact-head Telegram proof and focused compatibility validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded early discussion involvement and the cross-cutting channel-plugin API decision make steipete the strongest available routing candidate.
